{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df[~df['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter out refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(
    index=df_clean['channel'],
    columns=df_clean['customer_segment'],
    values=df_clean['converted'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
diffs = cross_tab.loc['email'] - cross_tab.loc['paid_search']
print('Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) by segment:')
print(diffs)

# Compute average treatment effect (ATE) across segments
# Weight by the proportion of each segment in the overall sample
segment_counts = df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
ate = (diffs * segment_counts).sum()
print(f'\nAverage Treatment Effect (ATE) across segments: {ate:.4f} ({ate*100:.2f} percentage points)')"}
